shared_or_similar_visual_information: Multiples of π differing only by a minus sign: 2π and −2π.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: Arc JK has numerical arc-length value 2π, in cm. Right image: The peak point has x-coordinate −2π.
Rationales: 2π and −2π differ in value; one labels an arc length and the other an x-coordinate. The π in the arc-length expression is not an angular unit.
